name: tododdle-support-workspace
description: npm workspaces root for the ToDoddle Support JavaScript and React Native SDKs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @krffl/tododdle-support && npm run build -w @krffl/tododdle-support-react-native
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @krffl/tododdle-support && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.check:generated: npm run generate:types && git diff --exit-code -- packages/js/src/generated
scripts.test: npm run check:version && npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:coverage: npm run check:version && npm run build && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
